liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Keep Your Day Job** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Reported as the last time the band played Keep Your Day Job; it was reportedly dropped at fans' request; Day Job here was the final performance of the song [4][18][19][25]
- **Smokestack Lightning** (3 reviews): A short, pretty improvised jam after Smokestack Lightning struck the listener as unique; He's Gone into Smokestack Lightning is judged the best extended playing of the show [17][24][26]
- **Box Of Rain** (2 reviews): The Box of Rain encore got the crowd excited; The Box of Rain encore struck the reviewer as an oddity [19][25]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Called the best Looks Like Rain ever; after the verses the whole audience claps together during Weir's rap [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ecnore Break**: back after 148 archived shows (720 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-04-04.148583.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1986-04-04.nak300.pasternak.mallick.103228.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Clean audience tape from a huge arena; the crowd is fairly quiet, though dynamic range is limited [24]
- **gd1986-04-04.schoeps.oade.gems.76152.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound good, with every band member audible [26]
- **gd1986-04-04.nak300.mandel.87246.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 132 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Bright, forward-sounding recording, the best of this show the listener has heard [22]
- **gd86-04-04.BeyerM88s.connor.29580.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 129 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [13]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the sound in the Civic Center as really bad, with an overall lack of energy [20]

## Around the show

- Three old friends who followed the band in the 1970s and hadn't seen them for six years attended [23]
- After Box of Rain, Phil rather than Bobby says thank you and good night [4]
- Reviewer would try many other shows from this East Coast tour before this one [19]
- Listener ranks it poorly among shows attended, though no longer in their worst five [20]
- Reviewer calls it the weakest of the Hartford shows they saw between 1974 and 1990, short on rock and roll [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-04-04.148583.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [1]. Also: Short patches from the Oade Schoeps source cover Dire Wolf, the Crazy Fingers to Greatest Story transition, and part of Drums [1]
- **gd1986-04-04.nak300.pasternak.mallick.103228.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Jon Pasternak and Dave Mallick; source: Nakamichi CM300's/CP4's>Marantz PMD-420>Cass(m) [7]
- **gd1986-04-04.schoeps.oade.gems.76152.flac16**: taped by Oades; transferred by Rich Gastwirt and GEMS; source: Schoeps CMC 44 Cardioids > Sony PCM F1 [10]
- **gd1986-04-04.nak300.mandel.87246.shnf**: taped by Brian Mandel; transferred by Brian Mandel; source: Nakamichi 300 Shotguns CP4's & Sony TCD5M [11]
- **gd86-04-04.BeyerM88s.connor.29580.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Charlie Connor; transferred by Charlie Connor; source: Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M (CM - TDK MA-R60 1st set; MA-R90 2nd set) [13]
